verdict.rationale: Riveter says any project can be scheduled to monitor for changes and keep data fresh, with refreshes as often as every minute and automatic competitor tracking. Runs execute asynchronously, and a webhook POSTs results to your URL on completion, so unattended background workflows are supported. Missing for 10: first-party docs on configuring schedules (API/SDK parameters, trigger types, management of recurring jobs), since scheduling evidence is marketing-level only, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
